name: Ertapenem
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 1 g IV or IM once daily; IV up to 14 days, IM up to 7 days
1 g IV once, 1 hour before incision

key_interactions.effect: Blocks tubular secretion; higher and longer drug levels (label).
Carbapenems lower valproate levels below the therapeutic range; breakthrough seizures (label).
key_interactions.action: Generally not recommended; prefer a non-carbapenem.

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to ertapenem or other carbapenems; anaphylaxis to beta-lactams
IM use: hypersensitivity to amide local anesthetics (lidocaine diluent)
monitoring: Seizure risk with CNS disease or kidney impairment

pk.half_life_eskd: Unbound AUC 7.6 times normal in end-stage kidney disease (label; no half-life given)
pk.metabolism: Hydrolysis to an inactive ring-opened metabolite
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 80% in urine (38% unchanged, 37% metabolite); 10% in feces
pk.dialyzability: Partly (about 30% of a dose in a 4-hour session)
